title: Chrono Engine Alternatives for Turn Based Combat?

posts.author: AmeerAshourDraws
posts.body:
It's been a while since I've dabbled into RPG Maker MZ, and while I'm looking forward to relearning a lot of stuff, I've been wanting to ask if there are alternative methods of making a Chrono Trigger-styled system other than the Chrono Engine. I have seen Victor Engine's On Map Battles for VX Ace, which is why I was wondering if there are any alternatives worth knowing should I reconsider my choices for the future.
I don't have a problem with the Chrono Engine itself, but I'm a bit of a newbie when it comes to scripting in RPG Maker as a whole (just started to learn how to do it), and I do plan on adding some custom systems of my own, but that would require a lot of editing in the Chrono Engine's base code, and anything I find about it is simply in ABS mode, not ATB mode.
And while I have made a prototype system of my own similar to Chrono Trigger using events, I am curious to see if anyone's done something similar to that game's battle system other than the Chrono Engine just to save some time. If there isn't, then that's fine.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Not that I know of. There just isn't a lot of motivation for another dev to make a Chrono Engine clone when only a few people use Chrono Engine to begin with and that other dev would be competing with free so he/she wouldn't make much trying to sell it.
You could theoretically rig something using another ABS or bullet plugin but that would be even more work than just editing Chrono Engine.

posts.author: AmeerAshourDraws
posts.body:
I see, thanks anyway!
I'll see what I can do
